posts.author: crispybliss
posts.body:
Hi everyone,
I've been playing around with RPG makers for a long time now, making little things here and there, prob started with rpg maker 2000 and I want to actually make a full game for once.
To get good at RMMZ on a deeper level and be part of the community, I'm offering to take people's plugin requests for free and have them be publicly available for all.
I've been using Javascript for a career for years so please don't hold back any complexities in your requirements, and part of the reason is so I can learn RMMZ!

posts.author: ZimXero
posts.body:
A few ideas:
A plugin that allows MZ users to present their skills (& options) during battle as icon buttons or skill bars that can be scrolled.  Stand alone would be fine.  Compatibility with basic Visustella plugins would be more useful yet.
A plugin that shows range on the battlefield (without grids), and lets characters choose between advancing and falling back, where character position can affect target options or damage calculations.
A plugin that gives menu or pushbutton access to external data such as PDFs, spreadsheets, or Websites.  This would give the ability to present interactive maps, sortable tables, skill lists, rules, walkthroughs, an encyclopedia, or a site where the player can upgrade their game from "demo" to "full version".

posts.author: Angy1910
posts.body:
Here are some ideas that I think no one developed for MZ!
You could make a plugin that lets you change the windows's position, size, and visibility like SRDude's
Super Tools Engine
and Graphical Design Mode for MV. It would be useful to move or hide (only visually, they still work) the Attack/Skill/Item/Escape and Party Status menus in battle.
Another idea is a plugin that lets you use the
mouse scroll wheel to navigate forward or backwards on menus like a list
and makes the
left  and middle click work as a Confirm button and the right click as a "Go back"
button
It would make sorting skills in battle much faster, and you would only need to use the mouse! This could work well with the skill icons that ZimXero suggested, making a vertical list.
I got this idea by seeing this video by
Masahiro Sakurai
.
It would also be cool to make it work on controller by making the player tilt half of the analog stick to scroll through the list. For Example, making a 180° tilt would go the last option in the list, a 90° tilt would select the middle option and so on..

posts.author: JegueAvapor
posts.body:
I was looking for a mv's plugin system that I've seen implemented in vxace:
Each character have 3 separate level parameters.
1 general level for the actor, which defines its base attributes.
1 level for class, which modifies your attributes and unlocks skills
1 level for race that works similar to class level.
The general level can go up to 99, but race and class levels only go up to 10.
During the game the player can change race/class to obtain other bonuses, but this does not affect their base level. Furthermore, when changing class/race, it is possible to change back to another previously used one, preserving the progress of the level already obtained
(example: Jhon has a base level of 30, with warrior 8/human 10. he switches warrior 8/angel 1. he decides to return to the human race so he returns to warrior 8/human 10)

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
@JegueAvapor
You can do most of that with Yanfly's Class Change and Subclass plugins.
The only other thing you'd need would be the "actor level" part - I'd probably use Yanfly's Actor Variables to track it and Base Parameter Control to have it affect parameters.
You could also use JP and Job Levels, there are a few approaches to take.
You may notice the OP has not logged in since October, and there's not been anything in this thread about a completed plugin since September - so waiting for a response is probably not a great use of your time
